title: Product Overview and Brand Heritage
text:
## Product Overview and Brand Heritage
The Citizen CX-02 digital photo printer is manufactured by Citizen Systems and distributed in the UAE by Kepler Tech LLC. It delivers high-quality dye-sublimation photo prints in a compact, portable chassis. The CX-02 joins Citizen's highly regarded CX printer range, offering new levels of quality, portability and compactness. Compared to previous CX models, it is 2kg lighter and 15% smaller.

title: Applications and Ideal Use Cases
text:
## Applications and Ideal Use Cases
The Citizen CX-02 is designed for commercial and professional photo environments:
- Retail and Kiosk installations
- Event Photography and Photo Party Booths
- Fast 8.4-second printing for 4 x 6 inch photos in High-Speed mode (or 8 seconds lab-quality print)
- Compact chassis (275 x 366 x 170 mm, 12 Kg) suitable for portable event setups

title: Key Advantages and Energy Saving
text:
## Key Advantages and Energy Saving
- Dye sublimation thermal system with overcoat for durable, protected prints.
- Front-loading drop-in paper loading and comfortable ribbon handling.
- Finishing options: Glossy or matte surface selectable through printer driver without changing media.
- Energy saving: Sleep mode reduces energy consumption by 98%.
- Ribbon rewind function: Prevents wasted ribbon and paper when printing single 4 x 6 inch photos using 6 x 8 inch media.

title: Dye-Sublimation Technology and Overcoat Protection
text:
## Dye-Sublimation Technology and Overcoat Protection
The Citizen CX-02 utilizes professional dye-sublimation thermal transfer technology with a clear protective overcoat:
- Instantly Dry and Water-Resistant: Prints emerge completely dry, laminated, and water-resistant immediately upon printing. The clear overcoat seals the photo against liquid spills, fingerprints, dust, and UV fading.
- Clean Operation: Unlike inkjet printers that rely on liquid ink cartridges that can clog, smear, or leak during transit, dye-sublimation uses solid dry ribbon panels, ensuring clean, reliable operation for mobile setups.
- Continuous Tone Lab Quality: Thermal heat fuses vaporized dyes directly into the synthetic paper surface, producing smooth continuous-tone gradations without visible dots or graininess at 300 dpi and 600 dpi resolution.
- Optimized for Event Photo Booths and High Traffic: Designed specifically for event party booths, retail kiosks, and mobile photographers requiring rapid, reliable, uninterrupted photo printing in 8.4 seconds (or 8 seconds).

title: Print Engine and Technology
text:
## Print Engine and Technology
- Printing Technology: Dye-sublimation thermal transfer system with overcoat
- Resolution Modes: 300 dpi (High Speed mode) and 600 dpi (High Quality mode)
- Main Interface: USB 2.0 full speed (Type-B connector)
- Media Loading: Quick front-loading drop-in paper mechanism and comfortable ribbon handling
- Instant Lamination: Clear protective top layer overcoat laminated during final pass for water, fingerprint, and UV resistance

section: Ribbon Rewind and Media Saving Feature
title: Ribbon Rewind and Media Saving Feature
text:
## Ribbon Rewind and Media Saving Feature
The Citizen CX-02 features an intelligent ribbon rewind function:
- Ribbon-Save Mechanism: When printing single 4 x 6 inch photos using 6 x 8 inch media, the printer prints on the first half of the ribbon panel and rewinds the ribbon, preventing waste of the remaining half.
- Energy Saving: Standby sleep mode reduces energy consumption by 98%.
- Long-Term Reliability: Engineered by Citizen Systems Japan for heavy-duty commercial duty cycles in event photography, retail kiosks, and mobile photo party booths.

title: Thermal Printhead Maintenance
text:
## Thermal Printhead Maintenance
- Thermal Head Cleaning: Periodic cleaning using the official Citizen Head Cleaning Pen (CITIZEN-PEN) removes thermal residue, dyes, and dust.
- Best Practice: Cleaning the thermal printhead each time paper and ribbon media are swapped prolongs printhead life and prevents print streak artifacts.

title: Supported Print Sizes
text:
## Supported Print Sizes
Print sizes supported by the Citizen CX-02 hardware:
- 4 x 6 inches (101 x 152 mm): 400 sheets per roll (sold in 2 roll pack CX2-MS46-2PC)
- 5 x 7 inches (127 x 178 mm): 230 sheets per roll (sold in 2 roll pack CX2-MS57-2PC, produces up to 460 prints per set)
- 6 x 8 inches (152 x 203 mm): 200 sheets per roll (sold in 2 roll pack CX2-MS68-2PC)
- 6 x 9 inches (152 x 229 mm): 180 sheets per roll (hardware supported by printer; 6x9 media sets not listed on Kepler Tech website)
- 3.5 x 5 inches (89 x 127 mm): hardware supported by Citizen CX-02 specifications

title: Print Speeds (Maximum)
text:
## Print Speeds (Maximum)
- 4 x 6 inches: 8.4 seconds in High-Speed mode (or 9.8 seconds in High-Quality mode). Lab-quality prints can be produced in approximately 8 seconds.
- 5 x 7 inches: 14.2 seconds.
- 6 x 8 inches: 15.6 seconds.
- 6 x 9 inches: 20.8 seconds.

title: Finishing Options and Surface Control
text:
## Finishing Options and Surface Control
- Two driver-selectable finishing options on the standard media: Glossy or Matte surface, selectable directly through printer driver software without replacing ribbon or paper.
- Citizen CX-02 driver settings also support Fine Matte and Luster finishes for professional portrait and studio applications.
- Note on Luster: The official datasheet specifies glossy and matte, while Citizen's manufacturer specifications also document luster and fine matte. Our team will confirm driver luster settings for your specific workflow.

title: Physical Dimensions and Weight
text:
## Physical Dimensions and Weight
- Size (W x D x H): 275 mm x 366 mm x 170 mm (27.5 x 36.6 x 17 cm)
- Product Weight: 12 Kg (printer unit; 2kg lighter than the CX model and 15% smaller)
- Package Weight: 13.5 Kg
- Package Dimensions: 39 x 50 x 33.5 cm (50 x 39 x 33.5 cm)
- Portability & Footprint: Ultra-compact and lightweight chassis designed to fit into small, cramped spaces, photo booth enclosures, and retail kiosks, making it easy to travel, transport, and set up on location.

title: Operating Systems and Connectivity
text:
## Operating Systems and Connectivity
- Supported Operating Systems: Mac OS X, Windows 7 & 10, Windows 11, Windows Server 2022
- Main Interface: USB 2.0 full speed
- Energy Saving & Sleep Mode: Sleep mode reduces energy consumption by up to 98%, entering a low-power dormant state when inactive (automatically after a period of inactivity or manually initiated) while ensuring quick and seamless return to full printing functionality.
- Paper & Ribbon Handling: Quick and easy media changing with drop-in paper loading and comfortable ribbon handling.
- Printer Driver: Improved printer driver provides real-time media status monitoring and selectable finishing options (Glossy, Matte, Fine Matte, Luster).

title: Official Accessories and Consumables Overview
text:
## Official Accessories and Consumables Overview
- Citizen CX-02 Printer Carry Bag (SKU: Citizen CX-02 Bag, internal id: CX-02-BAG): Sleek and durable bag designed specifically to fit and safeguard the Citizen CX-02 printer with a padded interior for transportation. Manufactured using abrasion-resistant foam-backed material with reinforced stitching and safety straps that pass under the bag. Features extra corner safeguarding, an embroidered Citizen logo, a robust two-clasp zip opening in one piece across top/rear panels, and a spacious main compartment accommodating printer, cables, power adapters, and media.
- Citizen Thermal Head Cleaning Pen (SKU: Citizen Pen, internal id: CITIZEN-PEN): Weight .250 kg. Compatible with Citizen CX-02, Citizen CX-02W, Citizen CY-02, and Citizen CZ-01 thermal printers. Designed specifically to clean thermal printheads on Citizen photo printers, ensuring crisp, clear printing results. Removes dyes, dust, dirt, and thermal debris to prevent print head scratches, streaks, and premature head failure. Recommended to clean the thermal head each time a new roll of media is installed.
- 4x6" Media Set (SKU: CX2.4x6, model: CX2-MS46-2PC): Genuine Citizen media containing 2 rolls (400 sheets per roll). Engineered for event photography, photo booths, and retail printing where speed and consistency are essential.
- 5x7" Media Set (SKU: CX0257, model: CX2-MS57-2PC): Genuine Citizen OEM media containing 2 rolls, produces up to 460 prints per set (230 sheets per roll). Delivers vibrant colors, sharp detail, and a durable protective overcoat.
- 6x8" Media Set (SKU: CX2.6X8, model: CX2-MS68-2PC): Genuine Citizen media containing 2 rolls (200 sheets per roll). Ideal for professional studio portraits, wedding albums, and high-end event photography workflows.

title: Citizen Photo Printers Lineup Overview
text:
## Citizen Photo Printers Lineup Overview
Kepler Tech LLC (Dubai) is an authorized partner and distributor for Citizen Systems commercial dye-sublimation photo printers across the GCC and UAE. The official Citizen photo printer range includes four specialized models:
1. Citizen CX-02: Compact, high-speed flagship for event booths and retail photo kiosks.
2. Citizen CY-02: Professional high-capacity commercial photo printer for fast, flexible volume production.
3. Citizen CZ-01: Ultra-compact, portable photo printer ideal for on-the-go photographers and tight spaces.
4. Citizen CX-02W: Wide-format commercial dye-sublimation printer producing larger 8x10 and 8x12 professional prints.
All four models feature a thermal dye-sublimation printing process, high-speed USB interface, compatibility with Windows 10/11 and macOS, and deliver crisp continuous-tone photo output at 300x300 dpi (high-speed) and up to 600x300 dpi (high-quality).
